locked.title: You can't edit this note now
locked.description: Your permissions don't allow changing it in its current state (a published note, for example).

form.title: Title
form.titleTooLong: The title is at most 200 characters.
form.bodyTooLong: The text is at most 10,000 characters.
form.numberingHint: Which series gives the note its number.

draft.recoveryDescription: A draft saved in this browser is available for this note.
draft.unavailable: This note is no longer available for editing in this session. The saved draft was kept.

delete.title: Delete this note?
delete.description: It moves to the recycle bin, where you can restore it until it is purged.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this note
conflict.etagUnavailable: The note's version could not be checked. Reload the note before saving; your draft is kept.
conflict.unavailable: The latest note cannot be read or edited now. Your draft is kept; no changes were sent.
conflict.reconcileHint: Choose which value to keep for each changed field. The save uses the latest version check.
conflict.retry: Try loading the latest version again

notFound.title: Note not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.

error.title: The note could not be loaded

chart.title: Notes per week
chart.description: Notes created in the last 8 weeks (weeks start on Monday, UTC).
chart.empty: No notes were created in the last 8 weeks.
